# 1. Data / 数据

The analysis unit is the **host genus** (`metadata$Genus`), not the host species of
Chapter 3. Three site tables are used: the merged CSS table (all samples of a
kingdom), the cleaned metadata, and the reference-mapped ASV universe
(`Merged_*_*_filtered.fa`, 23,021 16S and 5,072 ITS ASVs). Presence is defined as
CSS abundance > 0.

```{r data}
TAX_FILE <- c(
  `16S` = "filtered_merge/16S/Merged_16S_taxonomy_filtered.txt",
  ITS   = "filtered_merge/ITS/Merged_ITS_taxonomy_filtered.txt"
)
CSS_FILE <- c(`16S` = "css_16s_asvtab.txt", ITS = "css_its_asvtab.txt")
REF_FILE <- c(
  `16S` = "filtered_merge/16S/Merged_16S_Silva_filtered.fa",
  ITS   = "filtered_merge/ITS/Merged_ITS_Unite_filtered.fa"
)

md_all <- read_all_meta()
md_all[, Genus := trimws(as.character(Genus))]
tax_all <- lapply(TAX_FILE, function(f) {
  data.table::fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, f), sep = "\t")
})
names(tax_all) <- names(TAX_FILE)

ref_ids <- lapply(REF_FILE, function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(file.path(DATA_DIR, f), warn = FALSE)
  sub(" .*$", "", sub("^>", "", lines[grepl("^>", lines)]))
})

# Build the mapped presence matrix from the merged CSS table.  The result is
# cached because the 16S CSS table is ~425 MB; a cached copy is read on reruns.
build_presence <- function(ds, verbose = TRUE) {
  raw <- data.table::fread(css_merged_path(CSS_FILE[[ds]]),
                           sep = "\t", header = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE)
  asv <- as.character(raw[[1L]])
  sample_cols <- names(raw)[-1L]
  met <- md_all[dataset == ds]
  idx <- match(sample_cols, met$SampleID)
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    idx2 <- match(sub("^X", "", sample_cols), met$SampleID)
    idx[is.na(idx)] <- idx2[is.na(idx)]
  }
  keep_s <- !is.na(idx)
  if (any(!keep_s)) {
    warning(sprintf("%s: %d samples not found in metadata; dropped",
                    ds, sum(!keep_s)))
    sample_cols <- sample_cols[keep_s]
    idx <- idx[keep_s]
  }
  keep_asv <- asv %in% ref_ids[[ds]]
  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("%s: CSS %d ASV x %d samples; mapped ASV %d\n",
                ds, nrow(raw), ncol(raw), sum(keep_asv)))
  }
  m <- as.matrix(raw[keep_asv, which(keep_s) + 1L, with = FALSE])
  asv_m <- asv[keep_asv]
  rm(raw); invisible(gc())
  pres <- m > 0
  dimnames(pres) <- list(asv_m, sample_cols)
  mean_css <- rowMeans(m)
  rm(m); invisible(gc())
  met <- as.data.frame(met[idx])
  stopifnot(identical(met$SampleID, sample_cols))
  list(ds = ds, asv = asv_m, samples = sample_cols, presence = pres,
       mean_css = mean_css, meta = met)
}

load_presence <- function(ds, force = FALSE) {
  f <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), sprintf("presence_%s.rds", tolower(ds)))
  if (file.exists(f) && !force) {
    obj <- readRDS(f)
    if (all(c("dataset", "Genus", "source") %in% names(obj$meta))) {
      progress("read cached presence", ds)
      return(obj)
    }
  }
  progress("build presence from CSS", ds)
  obj <- build_presence(ds)
  saveRDS(obj, f)
  obj
}

pres <- list(
  `16S` = load_presence("16S", force = FORCE),
  ITS   = load_presence("ITS", force = FORCE)
)
for (k in names(pres)) {
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d samples x %d mapped ASVs; %.0f%% of samples have a host genus\n",
              k, ncol(pres[[k]]$presence), length(pres[[k]]$asv),
              100 * mean(!is.na(pres[[k]]$meta$Genus) &
                           pres[[k]]$meta$Genus != "")))
}
```

# 2. Shared helpers / 公共函数

## 2.1 Representative-T presence per host genus / 代表 T 的宿主属存在矩阵

For every host genus with at least `min_samples` samples, the number of
representative ASVs `T` is the mean per-sample ASV richness when richness is
normally distributed (Anderson-Darling, n >= 10) and the median otherwise. The
`T` most prevalent ASVs of that genus form its representative set, exactly as in
the species-level pipeline, with the host unit changed from species to genus.

```{r helpers-presence}
rep_presence <- function(obj, samples, min_samples = 3L, only_genera = NULL,
                         verbose = FALSE) {
  meta <- obj$meta
  if (!length(samples)) {
    return(list(P = NULL, T = data.table(), n_asv = nrow(obj$presence),
                n_genera = 0L, n_genera_all = 0L,
                n_qualified_samples = 0L))
  }
  stopifnot(all(samples %in% meta$SampleID))
  mi <- match(samples, meta$SampleID)
  gen <- trimws(as.character(meta$Genus[mi]))
  ok <- !is.na(gen) & gen != "" & gen != "NA"
  tab <- table(gen[ok])
  qual <- names(tab)[tab >= min_samples]
  if (!is.null(only_genera)) qual <- intersect(qual, only_genera)
  qual <- sort(qual)
  if (!length(qual)) {
    return(list(P = NULL, T = data.table(), n_asv = nrow(obj$presence),
                n_genera = 0L, n_genera_all = length(tab),
                n_qualified_samples = 0L))
  }
  P0 <- obj$presence[, samples, drop = FALSE]
  n_asv <- nrow(P0)
  G <- length(qual)
  Ttab <- data.table(genus = qual, n_samples = NA_integer_,
                     richness_mean = NA_real_, richness_median = NA_real_,
                     normality_p = NA_real_, rep_T = NA_integer_)
  idx_list <- vector("list", G)
  for (j in seq_len(G)) {
    cols <- which(ok & gen == qual[j])
    temp <- P0[, cols, drop = FALSE]
    prev <- Matrix::rowSums(temp)
    rs <- Matrix::colSums(temp)
    n_s <- length(cols)
    p_val <- NA_real_
    if (n_s >= 10L) {
      p_val <- tryCatch(nortest::ad.test(as.numeric(rs))$p.value,
                        warning = function(w) NA_real_,
                        error = function(e) NA_real_)
      if (is.na(p_val)) p_val <- 0
      T_s <- if (p_val > 0.05) as.integer(mean(rs)) else
        as.integer(stats::median(rs))
    } else {
      T_s <- as.integer(mean(rs))
    }
    T_s <- min(max(T_s, 0L), n_asv)
    idx_list[[j]] <- if (T_s >= 1L) order(-prev)[seq_len(T_s)] else integer(0)
    Ttab[j, `:=`(n_samples = n_s, richness_mean = mean(rs),
                 richness_median = stats::median(rs), normality_p = p_val,
                 rep_T = T_s)]
  }
  ii <- unlist(idx_list, use.names = FALSE)
  jj <- rep(seq_len(G), times = vapply(idx_list, length, integer(1)))
  P <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = ii, j = jj, x = 1,
                            dims = c(n_asv, G),
                            dimnames = list(obj$asv, qual))
  if (verbose) {
    cat(sprintf("  %d qualified genera; sum(T)=%d; median T=%d\n",
                G, sum(Ttab$rep_T), as.integer(median(Ttab$rep_T))))
  }
  list(P = P, T = Ttab, n_asv = n_asv, n_genera = G,
       n_genera_all = length(tab),
       n_qualified_samples = sum(ok & gen %in% qual))
}
```

## 2.2 Within-column null, threshold and classification / 列内零模型、阈值与分类

The null shuffles each host-genus column independently, holding the number of
representative ASVs per genus (`T`) fixed, 1,000 times. The generalist threshold
is the first host breadth at which the observed number of ASVs exceeds the null
expectation (crossing method, as in the species-level pipeline).

Throughout this chapter, **host breadth (HB)** is the number of distinct host
genera in which an ASV is detected. The result tables store it as
`host_breadth` (range 0-55 across the 16S and ITS data).

```{r helpers-null}
host_breadth_null <- function(P, n_iter = 1000L, seed = 20261201L) {
  cs <- Matrix::colSums(P)
  n_asv <- nrow(P); G <- ncol(P)
  actual <- tabulate(as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(P)) + 1L, nbins = G + 1L)
  null <- integer(G + 1L)
  set.seed(seed)
  for (it in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    cnt <- integer(n_asv)
    for (j in seq_len(G)) {
      if (cs[j] >= 1L) {
        sel <- sample.int(n_asv, cs[j])
        cnt[sel] <- cnt[sel] + 1L
      }
    }
    null <- null + tabulate(cnt + 1L, nbins = G + 1L)
  }
  list(actual_count = actual, null_count = null, n_iter = n_iter,
       col_sums = cs, n_asv = n_asv, n_genera = G,
       host_breadth = as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(P)))
}

# Exact expectation of the same within-column null: each column j contributes
# presence probability p_j = T_j / N independently, so a single ASV follows a
# Poisson-binomial with probabilities p_j.  This is the analytic mean of the
# 1,000-shuffle null (verified to agree to <0.3% of counts) and is used for the
# deterministic O/E, bootstrap and rarefaction calculations.
pb_pmf <- function(p) {
  pmf <- c(1, rep(0, length(p)))
  for (pj in p) pmf <- pmf * (1 - pj) + c(0, pmf[-length(pmf)]) * pj
  pmf
}
pb_counts <- function(Tvec, N) {
  pmf <- pb_pmf(Tvec / N)
  cnt <- N * pmf
  list(pmf = pmf, count = cnt, cum = rev(cumsum(rev(cnt))))
}

threshold_cross <- function(nr, exact = NULL) {
  act <- nr$actual_count
  nul <- nr$null_count / nr$n_iter
  max_t <- length(act) - 1L
  above <- which(act[2:length(act)] > nul[2:length(nul)])
  thr <- if (length(above)) above[1L] else {
    ts <- 0:max_t
    max(1L, ceiling(as.numeric(stats::quantile(rep(ts, times = nr$null_count),
                                               probs = 0.95))))
  }
  thr_exact <- NA_integer_
  if (!is.null(exact)) {
    above_x <- which(act[2:length(act)] > exact$count[2:length(exact$count)])
    thr_exact <- if (length(above_x)) above_x[1L] else max(1L, thr)
  }
  ts <- 0:max_t
  list(threshold = thr, threshold_exact = thr_exact,
       df = data.table(host_breadth = ts, actual = rev(cumsum(rev(act))),
                       null_expected = rev(cumsum(rev(nul))))
  )
}

classify_host_breadth <- function(nh, thr) {
  ifelse(nh == 0L, "NRH",
         ifelse(nh == 1L, "specialist",
                ifelse(nh >= thr, "generalist", "intermediate")))
}
```

## 2.3 O/E with host-genus bootstrap CI / O/E 与 bootstrap 置信区间

`O/E = observed generalists / expected generalists under the same null`. The
confidence interval resamples host genera with replacement 1,000 times; for each
resample the observed count is recomputed and the expected count is the exact
Poisson-binomial expectation for the resampled columns at the fixed threshold.

```{r helpers-oe}
oe_bootstrap <- function(P, k_star, n_asv, Tvec, B = 1000L, seed = 20261202L) {
  G <- ncol(P)
  set.seed(seed)
  obs <- integer(B); expv <- numeric(B)
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    mult <- tabulate(sample.int(G, G, replace = TRUE), nbins = G)
    nh <- as.integer(P %*% mult)
    obs[b] <- sum(nh >= k_star)
    pmf <- pb_pmf(rep(Tvec, times = mult) / n_asv)
    expv[b] <- if (k_star < length(pmf))
      n_asv * sum(pmf[(k_star + 1L):length(pmf)]) else 0
  }
  rr <- obs / expv
  rr[!is.finite(rr)] <- NA_real_
  list(oe_lo = unname(stats::quantile(rr, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
       oe_hi = unname(stats::quantile(rr, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
       obs_mean = mean(obs), exp_mean = mean(expv))
}

analyze_pool <- function(obj, samples, label, kingdom, grain, seed,
                         n_iter = 1000L, boot = 1000L, min_samples = 3L,
                         only_genera = NULL) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rp <- rep_presence(obj, samples, min_samples = min_samples,
                     only_genera = only_genera)
  if (is.null(rp$P) || rp$n_genera < 2L) {
    return(list(label = label, kingdom = kingdom, grain = grain,
                n_samples = length(samples), n_genera = rp$n_genera,
                n_genera_all = rp$n_genera_all,
                n_qualified_samples = rp$n_qualified_samples,
                T = rp$T, P = rp$P, ok = FALSE))
  }
  nr <- host_breadth_null(rp$P, n_iter = n_iter, seed = seed)
  ex <- pb_counts(rp$T$rep_T, rp$n_asv)
  th <- threshold_cross(nr, ex)
  cls <- classify_host_breadth(nr$host_breadth, th$threshold)
  obs <- sum(cls == "generalist")
  expc <- unname(ex$cum[th$threshold + 1L])
  oe <- if (expc > 0) obs / expc else NA_real_
  ci <- oe_bootstrap(rp$P, th$threshold, rp$n_asv, rp$T$rep_T,
                     B = boot, seed = seed + 7000L)
  progress(sprintf("pool %s: n=%d G=%d thr=%d GASV=%d O/E=%.2f",
                   label, length(samples), rp$n_genera, th$threshold,
                   obs, oe))
  list(label = label, kingdom = kingdom, grain = grain,
       n_samples = length(samples), n_genera = rp$n_genera,
       n_genera_all = rp$n_genera_all,
       n_qualified_samples = rp$n_qualified_samples,
       T = rp$T, P = rp$P, nr = nr, th = th, ex = ex,
       classes = cls, oe = oe, oe_lo = ci$oe_lo, oe_hi = ci$oe_hi,
       obs = obs, expected = expc,
       seconds = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), 1))
}
```

# 3. Pool definitions / 池定义

Pools are screened by the number of qualified host genera
(>= 3 samples per genus). A pool enters the analysis when it has at least 10
qualified genera. Coarse A is `IF_SD`, coarse B is `extract`, and medium is
`extract x IF_SD`. Pools that additionally stratify by `Region` (the finest,
region-level grain) are not analysed in v2: they are the smallest pools and the
most source-dominated (a single source contributes up to 88% of samples in such
a pool), so region-specific idiosyncrasies would otherwise leak into the
cross-pool consensus and consistency summaries.

```{r pools-def}
EXT_LAB <- c(Seed = "Seed", Germinating = "Germ")
ifsd_vals <- c("SD", "NSD")
ext_vals  <- c("Seed", "Germinating")

pool_defs <- list()
add_pool <- function(k, grain, label, samples) {
  pool_defs[[length(pool_defs) + 1L]] <<- data.table(
    kingdom = k, grain = grain, label = label, samples = list(samples))
}
for (k in c("16S", "ITS")) {
  md <- md_all[dataset == k]
  for (v in ifsd_vals) {
    add_pool(k, "Coarse A", sprintf("%s %s", k, v),
             md[IF_SD == v, SampleID])
  }
  for (v in ext_vals) {
    add_pool(k, "Coarse B", sprintf("%s %s", k, EXT_LAB[[v]]),
             md[extract == v, SampleID])
  }
  for (e in ext_vals) for (s in ifsd_vals) {
    add_pool(k, "Medium", sprintf("%s %s/%s", k, EXT_LAB[[e]], s),
             md[extract == e & IF_SD == s, SampleID])
  }
}
pool_defs <- rbindlist(pool_defs)
pool_defs[, grain := factor(grain, levels = c("Coarse A", "Coarse B",
                                              "Medium"))]
pool_defs[, n_samples := lengths(samples)]
pool_defs[, n_genera := mapply(function(s, kk) {
  g <- md_all[dataset == kk][match(s, SampleID), Genus]
  uniqueN(g[!is.na(g) & g != "" & g != "NA"])
}, samples, kingdom)]
pool_defs[, n_qualified := mapply(function(s, kk) {
  g <- md_all[dataset == kk][match(s, SampleID), Genus]
  g <- g[!is.na(g) & g != "" & g != "NA"]
  sum(table(g) >= 3L)
}, samples, kingdom)]
pool_defs[, included := n_qualified >= 10L]
setorder(pool_defs, kingdom, grain, label)
print(pool_defs[, .(kingdom, grain, label, n_samples, n_genera, n_qualified,
                    included)])
```

# 4. Merged analyses (main results) / 合并分析（主结果）

```{r analysis-merged}
merged_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_merged.rds")
if (file.exists(merged_cache) && !FORCE) {
  gos_merged <- readRDS(merged_cache)
  progress("loaded merged analyses cache")
} else {
  gos_merged <- list()
  for (k in c("16S", "ITS")) {
    seed <- 20261120L + match(k, c("16S", "ITS")) - 1L
    gos_merged[[k]] <- analyze_pool(
      pres[[k]], pres[[k]]$meta$SampleID, paste(k, "merged"), k,
      "Merged", seed = seed)
  }
  saveRDS(gos_merged, merged_cache)
}
for (k in names(gos_merged)) {
  r <- gos_merged[[k]]
  cat(sprintf("%s merged: %d samples, %d genera (%d ASVs); threshold %d; G=%d I=%d S=%d NRH=%d; O/E=%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)\n",
              k, r$n_samples, r$n_genera, r$n_asv, r$th$threshold,
              sum(r$classes == "generalist"), sum(r$classes == "intermediate"),
              sum(r$classes == "specialist"), sum(r$classes == "NRH"),
              r$oe, r$oe_lo, r$oe_hi))
}
```

```{r merged-tables}
merged_tab <- rbindlist(lapply(names(gos_merged), function(k) {

  data.table(kingdom = k, ASV_ID = pres[[k]]$asv, host_breadth = r$nr$host_breadth,
             category = r$classes, threshold = r$th$threshold,

}))
write_tab(merged_tab[kingdom == "16S"], CHAPTER, "Tab_4_gos_merged_16s")
write_tab(merged_tab[kingdom == "ITS"], CHAPTER, "Tab_4_gos_merged_its")
```

# 5. Pool analyses / 分池分析

```{r analysis-pools}
pool_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_pools.rds")
if (file.exists(pool_cache) && !FORCE) {
  gos_pools <- readRDS(pool_cache)
  progress("loaded pool analyses cache")
} else {
  gos_pools <- list()
  inc <- pool_defs[included == TRUE]
  # Seed indices follow the archived pool order so bootstrap CIs are stable
  # when non-analysis grains are excluded.
  # 种子序号沿用存档池顺序，保证排除非分析层级后 bootstrap CI 仍可复现。
  SEED_ORDER <- c(
    "16S NSD", "16S SD", "16S Germ", "16S Seed", "16S Germ/SD",
    "16S Seed/NSD", "16S Seed/SD", "16S V3_V4/Seed/SD", "16S V4/Seed/NSD",
    "16S V4/Seed/SD", "16S V5_V7/Germ/SD", "16S V5_V7/Seed/SD",
    "ITS NSD", "ITS SD", "ITS Germ", "ITS Seed", "ITS Germ/SD",
    "ITS Seed/NSD", "ITS Seed/SD", "ITS1 Germ/SD", "ITS1 Seed/NSD",
    "ITS1 Seed/SD", "ITS2 Seed/SD")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(inc))) {
    d <- inc[i]
    seed_i <- match(d$label, SEED_ORDER)
    stopifnot(!is.na(seed_i))
    seed <- 20261210L + 10L * (seed_i - 1L)
    obj <- pres[[d$kingdom]]
    res <- analyze_pool(obj, d$samples[[1]], d$label, d$kingdom, d$grain,
                        seed = seed)
    gos_pools[[d$label]] <- res
  }
  saveRDS(gos_pools, pool_cache)
}
# Pools are fitted independently with fixed seeds, so retaining only the
# analysis grains is numerically identical to recomputing those pools.
# 各池独立拟合且种子固定，仅保留分析层级与重算等价。
n_before_filter <- length(gos_pools)
gos_pools <- gos_pools[!vapply(gos_pools, function(r)
  as.character(r$grain)[1] == "Fine", logical(1))]
if (n_before_filter != length(gos_pools)) {
  progress(sprintf("dropped %d cached Fine pools; %d qualified pools retained",
                   n_before_filter - length(gos_pools), length(gos_pools)))
}
stopifnot(all(vapply(gos_pools, function(r)
  as.character(r$grain)[1] != "Fine", logical(1))))
cat("Qualified pools analysed:", length(gos_pools), "\n")
print(rbindlist(lapply(gos_pools, function(r) data.table(
  pool = r$label, kingdom = r$kingdom, grain = r$grain, n = r$n_samples,
  G = r$n_genera, thr = r$th$threshold,
  generalist = sum(r$classes == "generalist"),
  O_E = round(r$oe, 2)))))
```

## 5.1 Pool summary / 池汇总

```{r pool-summary}
pool_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pool_defs)), function(i) {
  d <- pool_defs[i]
  md <- md_all[dataset == d$kingdom][match(d$samples[[1]], SampleID)]
  top_source <- if (nrow(md)) max(prop.table(table(md$source))) else NA_real_
  r <- gos_pools[[d$label]]
  if (is.null(r) || is.null(r$nr)) {
    return(data.table(
      kingdom = d$kingdom, grain = as.character(d$grain), pool = d$label,
      n_samples = d$n_samples, n_genera = d$n_genera,
      n_qualified = d$n_qualified, n_qualified_samples = NA_integer_,
      threshold = NA_integer_, null_expected = NA_real_,
      generalist = NA_integer_, intermediate = NA_integer_,
      specialist = NA_integer_, NRH = NA_integer_,
      O_E = NA_real_, O_E_lo = NA_real_, O_E_hi = NA_real_,
      top_source_share = top_source, included = FALSE,
      exclusion = "fewer than 10 qualified genera"))
  }
  data.table(
    kingdom = d$kingdom, grain = as.character(d$grain), pool = d$label,
    n_samples = r$n_samples, n_genera = r$n_genera_all,
    n_qualified = r$n_genera, n_qualified_samples = r$n_qualified_samples,
    threshold = r$th$threshold, null_expected = round(r$expected, 2),
    generalist = sum(r$classes == "generalist"),
    intermediate = sum(r$classes == "intermediate"),
    specialist = sum(r$classes == "specialist"),
    NRH = sum(r$classes == "NRH"),
    O_E = round(r$oe, 3), O_E_lo = round(r$oe_lo, 3),
    O_E_hi = round(r$oe_hi, 3),
    top_source_share = round(top_source, 3), included = TRUE,
    exclusion = NA_character_)
}), fill = TRUE)
pool_summary[, grain := factor(grain, levels = c("Coarse A", "Coarse B",
                                                 "Medium"))]
setorder(pool_summary, kingdom, grain, pool)
```

## 5.2 Consensus generalists across pools / 跨池一致通才

```{r consensus}
pool_map <- unique(asv_classification[, .(pool, grain)])
cons <- asv_classification[, .(
  n_pools = .N,
  n_detected = sum(host_breadth >= 1),
  n_generalist = sum(category == "generalist")),
  by = .(kingdom, ASV_ID)]
grains <- asv_classification[category == "generalist",
                             .(generalist_grains = paste(sort(unique(as.character(grain))),
                                                         collapse = ",")),
                             by = .(kingdom, ASV_ID)]
cons <- merge(cons, grains, by = c("kingdom", "ASV_ID"), all.x = TRUE)
cons[, frac_generalist := n_generalist / pmax(n_detected, 1L)]
cons[, consensus := fifelse(n_detected == 0L, "undetected",
  fifelse(frac_generalist >= 0.5, "stable",
  fifelse(n_generalist >= 1L, "contextual", "never_generalist")))]
write_int(cons, CHAPTER, "generalist_sets")
cat("Consensus classes:\n"); print(cons[, .N, by = .(kingdom, consensus)])
```

## 5.3 Recurrent generalist annotation across qualified pools / 复发性通才注释

An ASV can cross the pool-specific threshold in one pool but not in another,
because both the threshold and the within-pool host breadth change. For every
ASV we therefore count the number of qualified pools of its kingdom in which it
was annotated as a generalist (denominator: the 7 qualified 16S pools and the
7 qualified ITS pools). Ties were broken by merged host breadth (`host_breadth`),
then by the number of pools in which the ASV was detected, then by `ASV_ID`. The
top 100 bacteria and top 100 fungi are reported with their reference taxonomy
(SILVA / UNITE); species-level labels are shown as annotated and are frequently
unassigned, especially for 16S.

```{r generalist-counts}
gen_counts <- cons[, .(kingdom, ASV_ID, n_pools,
                       n_detected_pools = n_detected,
                       n_generalist_pools = n_generalist)]
tax_flat <- rbindlist(lapply(names(tax_all), function(k) {
  d <- tax_all[[k]][, c("taxid", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus",
                        "Species"), with = FALSE]
  setnames(d, "taxid", "ASV_ID")
  d[, kingdom := k]
  d
}))
gen_counts <- merge(gen_counts, tax_flat, by = c("kingdom", "ASV_ID"), all.x = TRUE)
gen_counts <- merge(
  gen_counts,
  merged_tab[, .(kingdom, ASV_ID, host_breadth_merged = host_breadth,
                 merged_category = category, merged_detected = detected)],
  by = c("kingdom", "ASV_ID"), all.x = TRUE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(gen_counts$Phylum))
gen_counts[, frac_generalist_pools := n_generalist_pools / n_pools]
setorder(gen_counts, kingdom, -n_generalist_pools, -host_breadth_merged,
         -n_detected_pools, ASV_ID)
gen_counts[, rank := seq_len(.N), by = kingdom]
setcolorder(gen_counts, c("kingdom", "rank", "ASV_ID", "n_generalist_pools",
                          "n_pools", "n_detected_pools", "frac_generalist_pools",
                          "host_breadth_merged", "merged_category", "merged_detected",
                          "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"))
write_tab(gen_counts, CHAPTER, "Tab_4_generalist_pool_counts")
top_gen <- gen_counts[rank <= 100L]
write_tab(top_gen, CHAPTER, "Tab_4_generalist_top100_taxonomy")
print(top_gen[, .N, by = .(kingdom, n_generalist_pools)][order(kingdom, -n_generalist_pools)])
```

# 6. Comparisons and bias controls / 比较与偏倚控制

## 6.1 Matched-genus contrasts / 匹配属对比

Pools differ in their host-genus coverage. For each pair the contrast is repeated
on the intersection of qualified genera, so that both pools are evaluated on the
same host units.

```{r matched-pairs}
pairs <- list(
  c("16S SD", "16S NSD"), c("ITS SD", "ITS NSD"),
  c("16S Seed", "16S Germ"), c("ITS Seed", "ITS Germ"),
  c("16S Seed/SD", "16S Seed/NSD"), c("ITS Seed/SD", "ITS Seed/NSD"),
  c("16S Seed/SD", "16S Germ/SD"), c("ITS Seed/SD", "ITS Germ/SD")
)
matched_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_matched.rds")
if (file.exists(matched_cache) && !FORCE) {
  matched <- readRDS(matched_cache)
} else {
  matched <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(pairs)) {
    a <- gos_pools[[pairs[[i]][1]]]
    b <- gos_pools[[pairs[[i]][2]]]
    if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) next
    common <- intersect(a$T$genus, b$T$genus)
    if (length(common) < 2L) next
    ra <- analyze_pool(pres[[a$kingdom]], pool_defs[label == a$label, samples][[1]],
                       paste0(a$label, " [matched]"), a$kingdom, a$grain,
                       seed = 20261400L + 10L * i, boot = 500L,
                       only_genera = common)
    rb <- analyze_pool(pres[[b$kingdom]], pool_defs[label == b$label, samples][[1]],
                       paste0(b$label, " [matched]"), b$kingdom, b$grain,
                       seed = 20261400L + 10L * i + 1L, boot = 500L,
                       only_genera = common)
    matched[[length(matched) + 1L]] <- data.table(
      pair = paste(a$label, "vs", b$label),
      n_common_genera = length(common),
      pool_a = a$label, pool_b = b$label,
      OE_a = ra$oe, OE_lo_a = ra$oe_lo, OE_hi_a = ra$oe_hi,
      OE_b = rb$oe, OE_lo_b = rb$oe_lo, OE_hi_b = rb$oe_hi,
      d_OE = ra$oe - rb$oe)
  }
  matched <- rbindlist(matched)
  saveRDS(matched, matched_cache)
}
print(matched)
write_int(matched, CHAPTER, "matched_genus_contrasts")
```

## 6.2 Three seed scenarios (Seed/SD, SD, Seed/NSD) / 三种种子情景

```{r scenarios}
scen_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_scenarios.rds")
if (file.exists(scen_cache) && !FORCE) {
  scenarios <- readRDS(scen_cache)
} else {
  scenarios <- list()
  for (k in c("16S", "ITS")) {
    psd <- gos_pools[[sprintf("%s Seed/SD", k)]]
    pall <- gos_pools[[sprintf("%s SD", k)]]
    pnsd <- gos_pools[[sprintf("%s Seed/NSD", k)]]
    if (is.null(psd) || is.null(pall) || is.null(pnsd)) next
    asv <- pres[[k]]$asv
    cls_sd <- psd$classes; cls_all <- pall$classes; cls_nsd <- pnsd$classes
    new_epi <- cls_nsd == "generalist" & cls_sd != "generalist" &
      pnsd$nr$host_breadth >= 1
    lost <- cls_sd == "generalist" & cls_nsd != "generalist"
    abund <- pres[[k]]$mean_css
    detected_nsd <- pnsd$nr$host_breadth >= 1
    share_new <- sum(abund[new_epi]) / sum(abund[detected_nsd])
    tax <- tax_all[[k]][match(asv, taxid)]
    top_phy <- data.table(ASV_ID = asv[new_epi],
                          Phylum = tax$Phylum[new_epi])[
      , .N, by = Phylum][order(-N)][1:min(5, .N)]
    scenarios[[length(scenarios) + 1L]] <- data.table(
      kingdom = k,
      n_generalist_seed_sd = sum(cls_sd == "generalist"),
      n_generalist_sd = sum(cls_all == "generalist"),
      n_generalist_seed_nsd = sum(cls_nsd == "generalist"),
      n_new_in_seed_nsd = sum(new_epi),
      n_lost_from_seed_sd = sum(lost),
      abundance_share_new = share_new,
      top_phyla_new = paste(sprintf("%s(%d)", top_phy$Phylum, top_phy$N),
                            collapse = "; "))
  }
  scenarios <- rbindlist(scenarios)
  saveRDS(scenarios, scen_cache)
}
print(scenarios)
write_tab(scenarios, CHAPTER, "Tab_4_scenarios")
```

## 6.3 Rarefaction of qualified host genera / 合格宿主属稀释

```{r rarefaction}
rare_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_rarefaction.rds")
if (file.exists(rare_cache) && !FORCE) {
  rarefaction <- readRDS(rare_cache)
} else {
  rare_one <- function(r, seed, n_draw = 200L) {
    P <- r$P; N <- r$nr$n_asv; G <- ncol(P); Tj <- r$T$rep_T
    k_star <- r$th$threshold
    ks <- unique(c(seq(5L, min(G, 60L), by = 1L),
                   if (G > 60L) as.integer(seq(65L, G, length.out = 8L))))
    ks <- ks[ks <= G]
    set.seed(seed)
    rbindlist(lapply(ks, function(kk) {
      obs <- integer(n_draw); expv <- numeric(n_draw); det <- integer(n_draw)
      for (b in seq_len(n_draw)) {
        sub <- sample.int(G, kk)
        nh <- as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(P[, sub, drop = FALSE]))
        obs[b] <- sum(nh >= k_star)
        det[b] <- sum(nh >= 1)
        pmf <- pb_pmf(Tj[sub] / N)
        expv[b] <- if (k_star < length(pmf))
          N * sum(pmf[(k_star + 1L):length(pmf)]) else 0
      }
      oe <- obs / expv
      # With very few genera the null expectation is < 1 ASV and O/E is
      # numerically unstable; mark those draws missing rather than report
      # six-figure ratios.
      oe[!is.finite(oe) | expv < 1] <- NA_real_
      data.table(k_genera = kk, n_draw = n_draw,
                 mean_detected = mean(det),
                 generalist_rate = mean(obs) / N,
                 expected_count = mean(expv),
                 O_E = mean(oe, na.rm = TRUE),
                 O_E_lo = unname(stats::quantile(oe, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 O_E_hi = unname(stats::quantile(oe, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))
    }))
  }
  rarefaction <- rbindlist(lapply(names(gos_merged), function(k) {
    d <- rare_one(gos_merged[[k]],
                  seed = 20261500L + match(k, c("16S", "ITS")))
    d[, kingdom := k]
    d
  }))
  saveRDS(rarefaction, rare_cache)
}
print(rarefaction[seq(1, .N, by = max(1, floor(.N / 12)))])
write_tab(rarefaction, CHAPTER, "Tab_4_rarefaction")
```

## 6.4 Leave-one-source-out stability (merged analysis) / 留一来源稳定性

```{r loo-source}
loo_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "gos_loo_source.rds")
if (file.exists(loo_cache) && !FORCE && !RERUN_LOO) {
  loo <- readRDS(loo_cache)
} else {
  loo_one <- function(k, seed, min_samples = 3L) {
    obj <- pres[[k]]
    full <- gos_merged[[k]]
    full_set <- obj$asv[full$classes == "generalist"]
    srcs <- sort(unique(obj$meta$source))
    rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(srcs), function(i) {
      drop_s <- srcs[i]
      keep <- obj$meta$SampleID[obj$meta$source != drop_s]
      rp <- rep_presence(obj, keep, min_samples = min_samples)
      if (is.null(rp$P) || rp$n_genera < 2L) return(NULL)
      nh <- as.integer(Matrix::rowSums(rp$P))
      ex <- pb_counts(rp$T$rep_T, rp$n_asv)
      act <- tabulate(nh + 1L, nbins = rp$n_genera + 1L)
      above <- which(rev(cumsum(rev(act)))[2:(rp$n_genera + 1L)] >
                       ex$cum[2:(rp$n_genera + 1L)])
      thr <- if (length(above)) above[1L] else 1L
      cls <- classify_host_breadth(nh, thr)
      gset <- obj$asv[cls == "generalist"]
      data.table(kingdom = k, dropped_source = drop_s,
                 n_samples = length(keep), n_genera = rp$n_genera,
                 threshold = thr, n_generalist = length(gset),
                 jaccard_vs_full = length(intersect(gset, full_set)) /
                   length(union(gset, full_set)),
                 stable_retained = length(intersect(
                   gset, obj$asv[full$classes == "generalist" &
                                   full$nr$host_breadth >= 1])) /
                   max(1L, length(full_set)))
    }))
  }
  loo <- rbindlist(lapply(c("16S", "ITS"), function(k)
    loo_one(k, seed = 20261600L + match(k, c("16S", "ITS")))))
  saveRDS(loo, loo_cache)
}
cat(sprintf("LOO source: %d runs; Jaccard median %.3f (min %.3f)\n",
            nrow(loo), median(loo$jaccard_vs_full), min(loo$jaccard_vs_full)))
write_int(loo, CHAPTER, "loo_source_stability")
```

# 7. Host-breadth slope (HBS) across taxonomic ranks / 跨分类阶元宿主广度斜率

For each microbial taxon the host-breadth slope is the logistic coefficient of
`y_i = 1(ASV i belongs to the taxon)` on log2(host breadth) among ASVs with
host breadth >= 1 (the OHA term is not used in v2). Higher ranks are evaluated
at phylum and order for 16S and at class and order for ITS (class is the highest
rank resolved consistently in the UNITE taxonomy); both kingdoms also include
genus. Taxa need >= 20 ASVs and >= 3 distinct host-breadth values. FDR is
Benjamini-Hochberg within each taxonomic rank.

```{r hbs-helpers}
valid_taxon <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & x != "" &
    !x %in% c("Unassigned", "Incertae Sedis", "uncultured",
              "Unknown", "unclassified", "NA")
}

fit_hbs_rank <- function(cl, tax, rank_name, min_asv = 20L, min_h = 3L) {
  m <- merge(cl[, .(ASV_ID, host_breadth)],
             tax[, c("taxid", rank_name), with = FALSE],
             by.x = "ASV_ID", by.y = "taxid", all.x = TRUE)
  setnames(m, rank_name, "taxon")
  m <- m[valid_taxon(taxon)]
  tot <- m[host_breadth >= 1, .(n_total = .N), by = .(h = host_breadth)][order(h)]
  N_pos <- sum(tot$n_total)
  meta <- m[, .(total_asv_all = .N, n_h_all = uniqueN(host_breadth)), by = taxon]
  keep <- meta[total_asv_all >= min_asv & n_h_all >= min_h, taxon]
  gcnt <- m[host_breadth >= 1, .(n_in = .N), by = .(taxon, h = host_breadth)]
  out <- rbindlist(lapply(keep, function(g) {
    d <- merge(tot, gcnt[taxon == g, .(h, n_in)], by = "h", all.x = TRUE)
    d[is.na(n_in), n_in := 0L]
    d <- d[order(h)]
    if (nrow(d) < 3L || sum(d$n_in) == 0L) return(NULL)
    d[, x := log2(h)]
    fit <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(
      glm(cbind(n_in, n_total - n_in) ~ x, data = d, family = binomial(),
          control = glm.control(maxit = 100))), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    co <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    if (!"x" %in% rownames(co)) return(NULL)
    b <- co["x", "Estimate"]; se <- co["x", "Std. Error"]
    p <- co["x", ncol(co)]
    data.table(
      rank = rank_name, taxon = g,
      total_asv_all = meta[taxon == g, total_asv_all],
      total_asv_pos = sum(d$n_in), n_h_all = meta[taxon == g, n_h_all],
      n_h_pos = nrow(d), prev_overall_pos = sum(d$n_in) / N_pos,
      log2OR = b, OR = exp(b), OR_lo = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
      OR_hi = exp(b + 1.96 * se), p = p,
      direction = ifelse(b > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"),
      converged = isTRUE(fit$converged))
  }), fill = TRUE)
  if (!nrow(out)) return(NULL)
  out[, FDR := p.adjust(p, method = "BH")]
  out[, star := ifelse(FDR < 0.001, "***", ifelse(FDR < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", "")))]
  out[]
}

fit_hbs_all <- function(cl, tax, ranks = c("Phylum", "Order", "Genus")) {
  rbindlist(lapply(ranks, function(rk) fit_hbs_rank(cl, tax, rk)),
            fill = TRUE)
}

# Higher ranks differ by kingdom: 16S has a resolved phylum, whereas the
# UNITE ITS taxonomy is only consistently resolved from class downwards.
HBS_RANKS <- list(
  `16S` = c("Phylum", "Order", "Genus"),
  ITS   = c("Class", "Order", "Genus")
)
```

```{r hbs-merged}
hbs_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "hbs_merged.rds")

  hbs_merged <- readRDS(hbs_cache)
} else {

    cl <- merged_tab[kingdom == k]
    hbs_merged[[k]] <- fit_hbs_all(cl, tax_all[[k]], HBS_RANKS[[k]])
  }

}

    n_sig = sum(FDR < 0.05), n_up = sum(FDR < 0.05 & OR > 1),
    n_down = sum(FDR < 0.05 & OR < 1)), by = rank])
}
```

```{r hbs-by-pool}
hbs_pool_cache <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "hbs_bypool.rds")
if (file.exists(hbs_pool_cache) && !FORCE) {
  hbs_bypool <- readRDS(hbs_pool_cache)
} else {
  hbs_bypool <- rbindlist(lapply(names(gos_pools), function(lbl) {
    r <- gos_pools[[lbl]]
    cl <- data.table(ASV_ID = pres[[r$kingdom]]$asv,
                     host_breadth = r$nr$host_breadth)
    d <- fit_hbs_rank(cl, tax_all[[r$kingdom]], "Genus")
    if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
    cbind(kingdom = r$kingdom, grain = as.character(r$grain), pool = lbl, d)
  }), fill = TRUE)
  saveRDS(hbs_bypool, hbs_pool_cache)
}
# Pool fits are independent; keep only the retained grains.

cat(sprintf("By-pool HBS: %d genus x pool tests; %d significant positive\n",
            nrow(hbs_bypool), sum(hbs_bypool$FDR < 0.05 & hbs_bypool$OR > 1)))
write_int(hbs_bypool, CHAPTER, "hbs_bypool_genus")
```

# 8. Phylogenetic signal on the microbial tree / 微生物树上的系统发育信号

The microbial tree for this chapter is built de novo from the **10,372 16S
ASVs with host breadth >= 1** in the merged genus-level analysis (ASVs never
detected in a qualified host genus are excluded from both the alignment and
the tree). The server recipe is MAFFT `--auto` -> trimAl `-automated1` ->
FastTreeMP (`-nt -gtr -gamma`), followed by midpoint rooting with
`midpoint_root_ape.R`. `lambda`/`K` were run with `phylosig_fast.R` (pruning
lambda, 1,000-permutation Blomberg K) and Fritz & Purvis `D` with
`phylo_d_fast.R`; the per-tip trait is the genus-level host breadth / generalist
status from the merged analysis. The tree and statistics are supplied under
`server_result/ch4/`; the rebuild commands are in `scripts/server/ch4_gos_tree.sh`
and `scripts/server/ch4_phylosig_D.R`.
树与统计量随 `server_result/ch4/` 提供；重建脚本见 `scripts/server/`。

```{r tree-stats}

       call. = FALSE)
}

       "provide server_result/ch4/", call. = FALSE)
}
```

## 9.1 Generalist threshold (16S and ITS) / 通才阈值

```{r fig-threshold}
th_plot <- function(r, colour) {
  max_k <- min(r$nr$n_genera, 50L)
  ts <- 1:max_k
  df <- data.table(host_breadth = ts,
                   Actual = as.numeric(r$nr$actual_count[ts + 1L]),
                   Null = r$nr$null_count[ts + 1L] / r$nr$n_iter)
  df_long <- melt(df, id.vars = "host_breadth", variable.name = "distribution",
                  value.name = "count")
  df_long[, distribution := factor(distribution,
                                   levels = c("Actual", "Null"))]
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = host_breadth, y = log10(count + 1),
                      fill = distribution)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7,
             colour = NA, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = r$th$threshold, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Actual = colour, Null = "grey65"),
                      labels = c(Actual = "Observed", Null = "Null")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = log10(c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000) + 1),
                       labels = c("0", "1", "10", "100", "1,000", "10,000")) +
    labs(x = "Host breadth (no. of host genera)",
         y = "Number of ASVs (log10 scale)", fill = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

## 9.2 Phylum (16S) and class (ITS) composition across categories / 分类组成桑基图

```{r sankey-fun}
sankey_plot <- function(cl, tax, taxon_cols, top_n = 10L, rank_col = "Phylum",
                        node_labels = TRUE) {
  m <- merge(cl[, .(ASV_ID, host_breadth, category)],
             tax[, .(ASV_ID = taxid, Taxon = get(rank_col))],
             by = "ASV_ID", all.x = TRUE)
  m[is.na(Taxon) | Taxon == "", Taxon := "Unassigned"]
  m[, Category := factor(
    fifelse(category == "generalist", "Generalist",
      fifelse(category == "specialist", "Specialist",
        fifelse(category == "intermediate", "Intermediate", "NRH"))),
    levels = c("Generalist", "Intermediate", "Specialist", "NRH"))]
  top100 <- m[order(-host_breadth, ASV_ID)][1:100]
  top100[, Category := "Top100 host breadth"]
  cat_levels <- c("Top100 host breadth", "Generalist", "Intermediate", "Specialist")
  m4 <- rbind(
    m[Category %in% c("Generalist", "Intermediate", "Specialist")][
      , .(Category = as.character(Category), Taxon)],
    top100[, .(Category = "Top100 host breadth", Taxon)])
  m4[, Category := factor(Category, levels = cat_levels)]
  cnt <- m4[, .(n = .N), by = .(Category, Taxon)]
  cnt <- cnt[order(Category, -n, Taxon)]
  top <- cnt[, head(.SD, top_n), by = Category]
  nodes0 <- rbindlist(lapply(cat_levels, function(cc) {
    d <- cnt[Category == cc]
    tops <- top[Category == cc, Taxon]
    d[, Node := fifelse(Taxon %in% tops, Taxon, "Other")]
    d <- d[, .(n = sum(n)), by = Node]
    if (!"Other" %in% d$Node) d <- rbind(d, data.table(Node = "Other", n = 0L))
    d[, Category := cc]
    d
  }))
  nodes0[, Category := factor(Category, levels = cat_levels)]
  nodes0[, frac := n / sum(n), by = Category]
  glob <- m4[, .(total = .N), by = Taxon][order(-total, Taxon)]
  union_nodes <- unique(c(top$Taxon, "Other"))
  stack_levels <- c("Other", rev(intersect(glob$Taxon, union_nodes)))
  nodes <- nodes0[order(Category, match(Node, stack_levels))]
  nodes[, `:=`(ymax = cumsum(frac), ymin = cumsum(frac) - frac), by = Category]
  nodes[, x := as.numeric(Category)]
  W <- 0.32 * 1.15
  ribbon_df <- function(x1, x2, y1min, y1max, y2min, y2max, id, taxon,
                        type, n = 80L) {
    tt <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)
    ss <- tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt)
    data.table(x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * tt,
               ymin = y1min + (y2min - y1min) * ss,
               ymax = y1max + (y2max - y1max) * ss,
               id = id, Taxon = taxon, type = type)
  }
  pairs_l <- list(c("Top100 host breadth", "Generalist"),
                  c("Generalist", "Intermediate"),
                  c("Intermediate", "Specialist"))
  ribbons <- list(); k <- 0L
  for (pair in pairs_l) {
    L <- nodes[Category == pair[1]]; R <- nodes[Category == pair[2]]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(L))) {
      if (L$n[i] == 0L) next
      p <- L$Node[i]
      target <- if (p == "Other") "Other" else if (p %in% R$Node) p else "Other"
      rr <- R[Node == target]
      if (!nrow(rr) || rr$n[1] == 0L) next
      k <- k + 1L
      ribbons[[k]] <- ribbon_df(L$x[i] + W / 2, rr$x[1] - W / 2,
                                L$ymin[i], L$ymax[i], rr$ymin[1], rr$ymax[1],
                                k, p, ifelse(p == "Other", "other",
                                  ifelse(target == p, "shared", "dropout")))
    }
    extra <- setdiff(R$Node, c(L$Node, "Other"))
    lo <- L[Node == "Other"]
    if (length(extra) && nrow(lo) && lo$n[1] > 0L) {
      for (p in extra) {
        rr <- R[Node == p]
        if (!nrow(rr) || rr$n[1] == 0L) next
        k <- k + 1L
        ribbons[[k]] <- ribbon_df(lo$x[1] + W / 2, rr$x[1] - W / 2,
                                  lo$ymin[1], lo$ymax[1],
                                  rr$ymin[1], rr$ymax[1], k, p, "emerge")
      }
    }
  }
  ribbons <- rbindlist(ribbons)
  col_tot <- nodes[, .(n_total = sum(n)), by = Category]
  col_tot[, x := as.numeric(Category)]
  miss_col <- setdiff(unique(nodes$Node), names(taxon_cols))
  taxon_cols[miss_col] <- "#BDBDBD"
  taxon_cols["Unassigned"] <- "#9E9E9E"
  taxon_cols["Other"] <- "#D9D9D9"
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = ribbons[type %in% c("dropout", "emerge")],
                aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = id, fill = Taxon),
                alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
    geom_ribbon(data = ribbons[type == "shared"],
                aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = id, fill = Taxon),
                alpha = 0.55, colour = NA) +
    geom_ribbon(data = ribbons[type == "other"],
                aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = id),
                fill = "#D9D9D9", alpha = 0.45, colour = NA) +
    geom_rect(data = nodes, aes(xmin = x - W / 2, xmax = x + W / 2,
                                ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Node),
              colour = NA) +
    geom_text(data = if (node_labels) nodes[frac >= 0.02] else nodes[0],
              aes(x = x, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2, label = Node),
              size = 2.2, colour = "grey10") +
    geom_text(data = col_tot, aes(x = x, y = 1.02,
                                  label = sprintf("%s\n(n=%s)", Category,
                                                  format(n_total, big.mark = ","))),
              size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.95, vjust = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = taxon_cols, name = rank_col) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(cat_levels),
                       labels = cat_levels, limits = c(0.55, 4.45),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.14), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.28, "cm"),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
}
```

## 9.3 Host-genus HBS volcano / 宿主属 HBS 火山图

```{r fig-volcano}
volcano_plot <- function(d) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, sig := FDR < 0.05]
  d[, neglog10FDR := -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300))]
  lab_pos <- d[sig & OR > 1][order(-neglog10FDR)][1:min(10, .N)]
  lab_neg <- d[sig & OR < 1][order(-neglog10FDR)][1:min(5, .N)]
  labs <- unique(rbind(lab_pos, lab_neg), by = "taxon")
  ggplot(d, aes(x = log2OR, y = neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(size = total_asv_pos,
                   colour = fifelse(!sig, "NS",
                     fifelse(OR > 1, "Positive", "Negative"))),
               alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labs, aes(label = taxon), size = 2.2,
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.2,
                    min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Positive = COL_POS, Negative = COL_NEG,
                                   NS = COL_NS), name = NULL) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.4, 3.2), name = "ASVs") +
    labs(x = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth", y = "-log10(FDR)") +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "horizontal",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(0.15, "cm")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1),
           size = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 2))
}

vits <- volcano_plot(hbs_merged[["ITS"]][rank == "Genus"])
```

## 9.4 HBS genus x pool matrix / HBS 属 × 池矩阵

For each kingdom the matrix shows the top-ranked genera (16S: ten; ITS: five),
ranked by the number of analysed pools with a significant positive
host-breadth slope.

```{r fig-matrix}
# Merged (all-sample) HBS at genus level, shown as the leftmost column of
# each kingdom's matrix and included when ranking the top taxa.
merged_hbs <- rbindlist(lapply(c("16S", "ITS"), function(k) {
  d <- hbs_merged[[k]][rank == "Genus"]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  cbind(kingdom = k, grain = "Merged", pool = sprintf("%s merged", k), d)
}), fill = TRUE)

matrix_plot <- function(k, n_top = 10L) {
  pools <- pool_summary[kingdom == k & included == TRUE]
  cols <- rbind(
    data.table(pool = sprintf("%s merged", k), grain = "Merged"),
    pools[, .(pool, grain = as.character(grain))]
  )
  cols[, grain := factor(grain, levels = c("Merged", "Coarse A", "Coarse B",
                                           "Medium"))]
  d <- rbind(hbs_bypool[kingdom == k & pool %in% pools$pool],
             merged_hbs[kingdom == k], fill = TRUE)
  pos <- d[, .(n_pos = sum(FDR < 0.05 & OR > 1)), by = taxon]
  top <- pos[order(-n_pos, taxon)][1:min(n_top, .N), taxon]
  # y-axis labels carry the number of columns (merged + pools) with a
  # significant positive HBS association for that genus; x-axis labels
  # carry the number of qualified host genera analysed in each pool.
  y_labs <- setNames(
    sprintf("%s (%d)", rev(top), pos$n_pos[match(rev(top), pos$taxon)]),
    rev(top))
  col_n <- c(setNames(pools$n_qualified, pools$pool),
             setNames(gos_merged[[k]]$n_genera, sprintf("%s merged", k)))
  x_labs <- setNames(
    sprintf("%s (%d)", sub("^(16S|ITS) ", "", cols$pool), col_n[cols$pool]),
    cols$pool)
  x_labs[sprintf("%s merged", k)] <-
    sprintf("Merged (%d)", gos_merged[[k]]$n_genera)
  dd <- CJ(taxon = top, pool = cols$pool)
  dd <- merge(dd, d[, .(taxon, pool, log2OR, FDR)],
              by = c("taxon", "pool"), all.x = TRUE)
  dd[, tested := !is.na(log2OR)]
  # log2 OR of the host-breadth slope; untested genus x pool pairs are grey
  dd[, fill_val := fifelse(tested, log2OR, NA_real_)]
  dd[, star_lab := fifelse(
    tested & !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05,
    fifelse(FDR < 0.001, "***", fifelse(FDR < 0.01, "**", "*")), "")]
  dd[, pool := factor(pool, levels = cols$pool)]
  dd[, grain := cols$grain[match(pool, cols$pool)]]
  dd[, taxon := factor(taxon, levels = rev(top))]
  ggplot(dd, aes(x = pool, y = taxon)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_val), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = star_lab), size = 2.3, family = "Arial",
              colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = COL_NEG, mid = "white", high = COL_POS,
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2, 2), oob = scales::squish,
                         na.value = "grey90", breaks = -2:2,
                         name = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth") +
    facet_grid(~grain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = "Grey tiles: genus not tested in this pool (fewer than 20 ASVs or <3 host-breadth values). * FDR < 0.05; ** FDR < 0.01; *** FDR < 0.001") +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 6.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.8),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 5.8, hjust = 0),
          plot.caption.position = "plot")
}
```

## 9.5 Taxonomic-level HBS forest / 分类阶元 HBS 森林图

16S uses phylum, order and genus; ITS uses class, order and genus. The 16S
forest keeps phylum + order and genus as two panels. The ITS forest is rotated
90 degrees counterclockwise, so the three ranks form side-by-side columns
(class, order, genus) with the log2 odds ratio on the vertical axis.

```{r fig-forest}
forest_plot <- function(d, ranks = c("Phylum", "Order", "Genus")) {
  sig <- copy(d[FDR < 0.05 & rank %in% ranks])
  if (!nrow(sig)) return(NULL)
  sig[, rank := factor(rank, levels = ranks)]
  # keep at most 40 genus-level taxa (strongest effects) to stay readable
  if (nrow(sig[rank == "Genus"]) > 40L) {
    keep <- sig[rank == "Genus"][order(-abs(log2OR))][1:40, taxon]
    sig <- sig[rank != "Genus" | taxon %in% keep]
  }
  setorder(sig, rank, OR)
  sig[, direction := factor(direction, levels = c("Decreasing", "Increasing"))]
  sig[, y_id := factor(paste(rank, taxon, sep = "::"),
                       levels = rev(paste(rank, taxon, sep = "::")))]
  y_labs <- setNames(paste0(sig$taxon, " ", sig$star), as.character(sig$y_id))
  # Point and interval share one scale: the point is the logistic coefficient
  # b (log OR per doubling), and OR_lo/OR_hi = exp(b -/+ 1.96 SE), so their
  # natural logs are the Wald limits on that same scale; the half-width is
  # centred on b so the interval always straddles the point.
  # 点与区间同尺度：点为 logistic 系数 b（每翻倍 log OR），OR_lo/OR_hi =
  # exp(b ∓ 1.96 SE)，其自然对数即同一尺度上的 Wald 上下限，回填半宽到 b 两侧。
  sig[, `:=`(ci_lo = log2OR - (log(OR_hi) - log(OR_lo)) / 2,
             ci_hi = log2OR + (log(OR_hi) - log(OR_lo)) / 2)]
  x_rng <- range(c(sig$log2OR, sig$ci_lo, sig$ci_hi), na.rm = TRUE)
  x_brk <- pretty(x_rng, n = 5)
  x_lims <- range(c(x_rng, x_brk)) + c(-0.2, 0.2)
  p <- ggplot(sig, aes(log2OR, y_id, colour = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi), size = 0.18,
                    linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lims, breaks = x_brk) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Decreasing = COL_NEG,
                                   Increasing = COL_POS), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth", y = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.2),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"),
          legend.position = "bottom")
  # rank strips above each panel (including the single-rank Genus panel)
  p <- p + facet_wrap(~ rank, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
                      strip.position = "top")
  p
}
# Rotated layout for ITS: taxa along the x-axis and OR on the vertical axis,
# so the three ranks appear as side-by-side columns (Class | Order | Genus).
forest_plot_h <- function(d, ranks = c("Class", "Order", "Genus")) {
  sig <- copy(d[FDR < 0.05 & rank %in% ranks])
  if (!nrow(sig)) return(NULL)
  sig[, rank := factor(rank, levels = ranks)]
  if (nrow(sig[rank == "Genus"]) > 40L) {
    keep <- sig[rank == "Genus"][order(-abs(log2OR))][1:40, taxon]
    sig <- sig[rank != "Genus" | taxon %in% keep]
  }
  setorder(sig, rank, OR)
  sig[, direction := factor(direction, levels = c("Decreasing", "Increasing"))]
  sig[, x_id := factor(paste(rank, taxon, sep = "::"),
                       levels = paste(rank, taxon, sep = "::"))]
  x_labs <- setNames(paste0(sig$taxon, " ", sig$star), as.character(sig$x_id))
  # Point and interval share one scale: the point is the logistic coefficient
  # b (log OR per doubling), and OR_lo/OR_hi = exp(b -/+ 1.96 SE), so their
  # natural logs are the Wald limits on that same scale; the half-width is
  # centred on b so the interval always straddles the point.
  # 点与区间同尺度：点为 logistic 系数 b（每翻倍 log OR），OR_lo/OR_hi =
  # exp(b ∓ 1.96 SE)，其自然对数即同一尺度上的 Wald 上下限，回填半宽到 b 两侧。
  sig[, `:=`(ci_lo = log2OR - (log(OR_hi) - log(OR_lo)) / 2,
             ci_hi = log2OR + (log(OR_hi) - log(OR_lo)) / 2)]
  y_rng <- range(c(sig$log2OR, sig$ci_lo, sig$ci_hi), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_brk <- pretty(y_rng, n = 5)
  y_lims <- range(c(y_rng, y_brk)) + c(-0.2, 0.2)
  ggplot(sig, aes(x_id, log2OR, colour = direction)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), size = 0.18,
                    linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_lims, breaks = y_brk) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Decreasing = COL_NEG,
                                   Increasing = COL_POS), name = NULL) +
    facet_grid(~rank, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth") +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                     size = 5.8),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
          legend.position = "top")
}

# 16S: two-column layout, Phylum + Order on the left and Genus on the right
f16_l <- forest_plot(hbs_merged[["16S"]], c("Phylum", "Order"))
f16_r <- forest_plot(hbs_merged[["16S"]], "Genus")
fits <- forest_plot_h(hbs_merged[["ITS"]], HBS_RANKS[["ITS"]])
f16 <- if (!is.null(f16_l) && !is.null(f16_r)) {
  (f16_l + f16_r + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15), guides = "collect")) &
    theme(legend.position = "top")
} else NULL
if (!is.null(f16)) save_fig(f16, CHAPTER, "Fig_4_taxon_forest_16s", 150, 120)
if (!is.null(f16)) embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_4_taxon_forest_16s")
if (!is.null(fits)) save_fig(fits, CHAPTER, "Fig_4_its_taxon_forest", 150, 100)
if (!is.null(fits)) embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_4_its_taxon_forest")
```

## 9.6 Genus composition of recurrent generalists (Sankey) / 复发性通才属组成

Recurrent generalists are shown as a two-panel Sankey diagram (bacteria on the
left, fungi on the right). ASVs annotated as generalists in at least five of
the seven qualified pools are retained, separating the 7-, 6- and 5-pool strata
(the ">5" rule is applied as >= 5 so that the 5-pool stratum described below is
represented). In each panel the left column shows the size and proportion of
each stratum; the right column shows the fifteen genera contributing the most
ASVs among these recurrent generalists, with the remaining genera pooled as
"Other". Ribbons connect each stratum to the genera of its ASVs. For ITS,
unassigned genus labels are kept as "Unassigned".

```{r fig-recurrent-sankey}
recur_sankey <- function(k, panel_title) {
  d <- gen_counts[kingdom == k & n_generalist_pools >= 5L,
                  .(ASV_ID, Count = n_generalist_pools, Genus)]
  d[is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", Genus := "Unassigned"]
  ord <- d[, .(N = .N, top_count = max(Count)), by = Genus][
    order(-N, -top_count, Genus)]
  keep <- head(ord$Genus, 15L)
  d[, Genus := fifelse(Genus %in% keep, Genus, "Other")]

  left_lev <- sort(unique(d$Count), decreasing = TRUE)
  right_lev <- c(ord[Genus %in% keep, Genus], "Other")
  d[, Count := factor(Count, levels = left_lev)]
  d[, Genus := factor(Genus, levels = right_lev)]

  n_tot <- nrow(d)
  W <- 0.13; xl <- 1; xr <- 2
  stack_nodes <- function(dt, key, lev) {
    nd <- dt[, .N, by = key]
    setnames(nd, key, "Node")
    nd[, Node := factor(Node, levels = lev)]
    setorder(nd, Node)
    nd[, frac := N / n_tot]
    nd[, `:=`(ytop = 1 - (cumsum(frac) - frac), ybot = 1 - cumsum(frac))]
    nd
  }
  L <- stack_nodes(d, "Count", left_lev)
  R <- stack_nodes(d, "Genus", right_lev)

  seg <- d[, .N, by = .(Count, Genus)]
  seg[, frac := N / n_tot]
  segL <- seg[order(Count, Genus)]
  segL[, `:=`(yl_top = L$ytop[match(Count, L$Node)] -
                       (cumsum(frac) - frac),
              yl_bot = L$ytop[match(Count, L$Node)] - cumsum(frac)),
       by = Count]
  segR <- seg[order(Genus, Count)]
  segR[, `:=`(yr_top = R$ytop[match(Genus, R$Node)] -
                       (cumsum(frac) - frac),
              yr_bot = R$ytop[match(Genus, R$Node)] - cumsum(frac)),
       by = Genus]
  flows <- merge(segL[, .(Count, Genus, yl_top, yl_bot)],
                 segR[, .(Count, Genus, yr_top, yr_bot)],
                 by = c("Count", "Genus"))

  ribbons <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(flows)), function(i) {
    tt <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 60)
    ss <- tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt)
    data.table(
      x = (xl + W / 2) + ((xr - W / 2) - (xl + W / 2)) * tt,
      ymin = flows$yl_bot[i] + (flows$yr_bot[i] - flows$yl_bot[i]) * ss,
      ymax = flows$yl_top[i] + (flows$yr_top[i] - flows$yl_top[i]) * ss,
      id = i, Count = flows$Count[i])
  }))

  count_cols <- setNames(
    c("7" = "#1D3557", "6" = "#457B9D", "5" = "#A8DADC")[
      as.character(left_lev)], as.character(left_lev))
  gen_cols <- setNames(PAL_QUAL[seq_along(right_lev)], right_lev)
  gen_cols["Other"] <- "#D9D9D9"
  gen_cols["Unassigned"] <- "#4D4D4D"

  labL <- L[, .(x = xl - W / 2 - 0.03, y = (ytop + ybot) / 2,
                lab = sprintf("%s pools\nn=%d (%.1f%%)",
                              as.character(Node), N, 100 * frac))]
  labR <- R[, .(x = xr + W / 2 + 0.03, y = (ytop + ybot) / 2,
                lab = sprintf("%s (%d)", as.character(Node), N))]
  head_lab <- data.table(
    x = c(xl, xr), y = 1.05,
    lab = c(sprintf("Generalist pools\nn=%d ASVs", n_tot),
            "Top 15 genera"))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = ribbons, aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
                                    group = id, fill = Count),
                alpha = 0.45, colour = NA) +
    geom_rect(data = L, aes(xmin = xl - W / 2, xmax = xl + W / 2,
                            ymin = ybot, ymax = ytop, fill = Node),
              colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = count_cols, guide = "none") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_rect(data = R, aes(xmin = xr - W / 2, xmax = xr + W / 2,
                            ymin = ybot, ymax = ytop, fill = Node),
              colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gen_cols, guide = "none") +
    geom_text_repel(data = labL, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
                    hjust = 1, size = 2.2, direction = "y",
                    nudge_x = -0.06, min.segment.length = 0,
                    segment.size = 0.2, segment.colour = "grey55",
                    box.padding = 0.12, max.overlaps = Inf, colour = "grey10") +
    geom_text_repel(data = labR, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
                    hjust = 0, size = 2.2, direction = "y", nudge_x = 0.06,
                    min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2,
                    segment.colour = "grey55", box.padding = 0.12,
                    max.overlaps = Inf) +
    geom_text(data = head_lab, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab), size = 2.6,
              fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.95, vjust = 0) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.45, 3.0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.12), expand = c(0, 0),
                       oob = scales::squish) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(title = panel_title)

  write_int(d[, .(kingdom = k, ASV_ID,
                  n_generalist_pools = as.integer(as.character(Count)),
                  Genus = as.character(Genus))],
            CHAPTER, paste0("recurrent_generalist_asv_", tolower(k)))
  p
}
p_sankey_16s <- recur_sankey("16S", "Bacteria (16S)")
p_sankey_its <- recur_sankey("ITS", "Fungi (ITS)")
p_sankey <- p_sankey_16s + p_sankey_its + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
save_fig(p_sankey, CHAPTER, "Fig_4_generalist_sankey", 240, 120)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_4_generalist_sankey")
```

## 9.7 Abundance–host-breadth curves / 丰度–宿主广度曲线

Following the previous analysis pipeline, each ASV contributes one point: `x`
is its host breadth and `y` is the log10 of its mean relative abundance across
the samples in which that ASV is detected (per-sample relative abundance, i.e.
CSS divided by the sample total over mapped ASVs; samples without mapped reads
are dropped). Restricting the mean to detected samples avoids penalising
low-breadth ASVs. Each scatter is accompanied by a linear fit, its 95%
confidence band and a one-sided Spearman test for a positive association.
Bacteria (16S) and fungi (ITS) are shown side by side, each pooling all ASVs
with host breadth ≥ 1; colour encodes abundance, point size scales with
log2(host breadth) + 1, and a horizontal jitter separates ASVs that share an
integer host breadth. Both panels share the colour scale, the y-axis range and
the legend.

```{r abund-helpers}
suppressMessages(library(gridExtra))

abund_subplot <- function(dt, stat_row, color_limits, y_limits,
                          legend = "none", metric_size = 2.2) {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  n_asv <- stat_row$n_asv; n_pts <- nrow(dt); mean_h <- stat_row$mean_h
  p_pos <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(
    dt$host_breadth, dt$log10_rel, method = "spearman",
    alternative = "greater")$p.value), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  xr <- range(dt$host_breadth); y_lo <- y_limits[1]
  has_fit <- n_pts >= 3L && uniqueN(dt$host_breadth) >= 2L
  fit_lab <- character(0); band <- NULL
  if (has_fit) {
    fit <- tryCatch(stats::lm(log10_rel ~ host_breadth, data = dt),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      cf <- stats::coef(fit); r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
      eq <- sprintf("y = %sx %s %.3f",
                    formatC(cf[2], digits = 3, format = "g"),
                    ifelse(cf[1] < 0, "-", "+"), abs(cf[1]))
      fit_lab <- c(eq, sprintf("R² = %.3f", r2))
      xseq <- seq(min(dt$host_breadth), max(dt$host_breadth), length.out = 200)
      pr <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(host_breadth = xseq),
                           se.fit = TRUE)
      crit <- stats::qt(0.975, df = fit$df.residual)
      band <- data.frame(x = xseq, yfit = pr$fit,
                         lo = pr$fit - crit * pr$se.fit,
                         hi = pr$fit + crit * pr$se.fit)
      band$lo <- pmax(band$lo, y_lo); band$hi <- pmin(band$hi, 0)
      band$yfit <- pmin(pmax(band$yfit, y_lo), 0)
    }
  }
  p_star <- if (is.na(p_pos)) "NA" else if (p_pos < 0.001) "***" else
    if (p_pos < 0.01) "**" else if (p_pos < 0.05) "*" else "ns"
  metric_lab <- paste(c(sprintf("ASVs: %d", n_asv),
    sprintf("mean host breadth: %.2f", mean_h), sprintf("P_pos: %s", p_star),
    fit_lab), collapse = "\n")
  abund_cols <- c("#93BCD0", "#93BCD0", "#FCB366", "#FE816F", "#FE816F")
  abund_vals <- c(0, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65, 1)
  p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = host_breadth, y = log10_rel, colour = log10_rel,
                      size = log2(host_breadth) + 1)) +
    # jitter only separates ASVs with the same integer host breadth; the fit
    # and its band use the unjittered x
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.45, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = abund_cols, values = abund_vals,
      limits = color_limits, breaks = pretty(color_limits, n = 4),
      name = "log10\nrel. abund.") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.2, 1.4), breaks = 1:6,
                          name = "log2(HB) + 1")
  if (!is.null(band)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_ribbon(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  aes(x = x, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "grey60",
                  alpha = 0.35) +
      geom_line(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = yfit),
                colour = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
      geom_line(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = lo),
                colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_line(data = band, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(x = x, y = hi),
                colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "dashed")
  }
  p + scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0))) +
    annotate("label", x = xr[2], y = y_lo, label = metric_lab,
             size = metric_size, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
             fill = grDevices::rgb(1, 1, 1, 0.85), linewidth = 0.2,
             label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "black"),
          legend.position = legend,
          legend.box = if (legend == "bottom") "horizontal" else "vertical",
          legend.key.height = unit(0.32, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
}

abund_banner <- function(p, grp_name, banner_h = 0.28, scatter_h = 2.4,
                         banner_size = 3.2) {
  banner <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 0, y = 0, lab = grp_name),
                   aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab)) +
    geom_text(fontface = "bold", size = banner_size) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", colour = "grey35",
                                         linewidth = 0.3),
          plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
  arrangeGrob(banner, ggplotGrob(p), ncol = 1, heights = c(banner_h, scatter_h))
}

abund_legend <- function(p) {
  gt <- ggplotGrob(p)
  idx <- which(grepl("^guide-box", gt$layout$name))
  idx <- idx[vapply(idx, function(k) {
    g <- gt$grobs[[k]]; !is.null(g) && !inherits(g, "zeroGrob")
  }, logical(1))]
  if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
  gs <- lapply(idx, function(k) gt$grobs[[k]])
  if (length(gs) == 1L) gs[[1L]] else arrangeGrob(grobs = gs, nrow = 1L)
}
```

```{r abund-asvmean-data}
abund_asvmean <- function(k) {
  f <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), sprintf("abund_asvmean_%s.rds", tolower(k)))
  if (file.exists(f) && !FORCE) return(readRDS(f))
  css <- data.table::fread(css_merged_path(CSS_FILE[[k]]), sep = "\t")
  asv_all <- as.character(css[[1L]])
  keep <- asv_all %in% pres[[k]]$asv
  asv <- asv_all[keep]
  sample_cols <- pres[[k]]$samples
  m <- as.matrix(css[keep, sample_cols, with = FALSE])
  rm(css); invisible(gc())
  cs <- colSums(m)
  ok_cs <- cs > 0
  mm <- m[, ok_cs, drop = FALSE]
  cs2 <- cs[ok_cs]
  # average each ASV over the samples where it is detected (CSS > 0), so
  # rarely detected ASVs are not diluted by absences
  n_det <- rowSums(mm > 0)
  sum_rel <- as.numeric(mm %*% (1 / cs2))
  rel_mean <- sum_rel / n_det
  rm(m, mm); invisible(gc())
  d <- data.table::data.table(ASV_ID = asv, mean_rel = rel_mean,
                              n_detected = n_det,
                              log10_rel = log10(rel_mean))
  d <- merge(d, merged_tab[kingdom == k,
                           .(ASV_ID, host_breadth, category)], by = "ASV_ID")
  d <- d[host_breadth >= 1L]
  gc_col <- if (k == "16S") "Phylum" else "Class"
  d[, grp := tax_all[[k]][[gc_col]][match(ASV_ID, tax_all[[k]]$taxid)]]
  d[is.na(grp) | grp == "", grp := "Unassigned"]
  saveRDS(d, f)
  d
}
abund_asv <- list(`16S` = abund_asvmean("16S"), ITS = abund_asvmean("ITS"))
progress(sprintf("merged abundance curves: %d 16S ASVs, %d ITS ASVs",
                 nrow(abund_asv[["16S"]]), nrow(abund_asv$ITS)))
```

## 9.8 Host breadth on the microbial tree / 微生物树上的宿主广度

```{r fig-tree, fig.width=7.1, fig.height=6.7}
suppressMessages({
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggtreeExtra)
  library(ggnewscale)
})
tr <- ape::read.tree(tree_file)
ann_tree <- data.table(taxid = pres$`16S`$asv,
                       host_breadth = gos_merged[["16S"]]$nr$host_breadth,
                       category = gos_merged[["16S"]]$classes)
ann_tree <- ann_tree[match(tr$tip.label, taxid)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(ann_tree$taxid), all(ann_tree$host_breadth >= 1))
ann_tree[, host_breadth_cap := pmin(host_breadth, 20)]
ann_tree[, cat4 := factor(fifelse(category == "generalist", "Generalist",
                    fifelse(category == "intermediate", "Intermediate",
                      fifelse(category == "specialist", "Specialist", "NRH"))),
                    levels = c("Generalist", "Intermediate", "Specialist",
                               "NRH"))]
ann_df <- as.data.frame(ann_tree)
p_tree <- ggtree(tr, layout = "circular", size = 0.02, colour = "grey75")
# inner ring: generalist / intermediate / specialist / NRH
p_tree <- p_tree +
  geom_fruit(data = ann_df, geom = geom_tile,
             mapping = aes(y = taxid, fill = cat4),
             width = 0.05, offset = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Generalist = "#E67E22", Intermediate = "#F4A261",
               Specialist = "#547FB6", NRH = "#E5E5E5"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1, title = "Category")) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # outer ring: continuous host breadth (host_breadth), capped at 20 for colour
  geom_fruit(data = ann_df, geom = geom_tile,
             mapping = aes(y = taxid, fill = host_breadth_cap),
             width = 0.05, offset = 0.07) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#DDF2C8", "#C6E3AE", "#ADD565", "#78A495", "#3A5A40",
                "#1D3557"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(1, 2, 4, 8, 14, 20)),
    limits = c(1, 20), oob = scales::squish, name = "Host breadth",
    guide = guide_colourbar(order = 2, barheight = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                            barwidth = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.28, "cm"))
stat_lab <- character(0)
if (nrow(phy_stats)) {
  lam <- phy_stats[method == "Pagel_lambda"][1]
  kk <- phy_stats[method == "Blomberg_K"][1]
  stat_lab <- c(stat_lab,
    sprintf("lambda = %.3f (P %s)", lam$estimate,
            ifelse(lam$P < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf("= %.3f", lam$P))),
    sprintf("K = %.2e (P = %.3f)", kk$estimate, kk$P))
}
if (nrow(d_stats)) {
  dd <- d_stats[1]
  stat_lab <- c(stat_lab,
    sprintf("D = %.3f (P(D=1) = %.3f)", dd$D, dd$P_random))
}
p_tree <- p_tree +
  labs(caption = paste(stat_lab, collapse = "; ")) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0))
save_fig(p_tree, CHAPTER, "Fig_4_microbial_tree_host_breadth", 180, 170)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_4_microbial_tree_host_breadth")
```
